# Benford Consulting, LLC

> Faithful Stewardship. Sound Financial Guidance.

Benford Consulting, LLC is a CPA firm serving individuals and business owners in the Florence–Tuscumbia / Shoals region of Alabama. The firm helps clients manage finances with wisdom, clarity, and integrity.

## Entity

- Legal name: Benford Consulting, LLC
- Website: https://www.benfordcpa.com
- Public email: kbenfordcpa@gmail.com
- Founder: Kolby Benford, licensed CPA in Alabama (certified 2022)
- Service area: Florence, Tuscumbia, Muscle Shoals, Sheffield, and the broader Shoals, AL area
- Phone / street address: not published publicly at this time

## Services

1. Tax Planning — specializing in real estate taxation
2. Virtual CFO — strategic financial guidance for growing businesses
3. Tax Preparation — personal and business returns
4. Accounting System Setup — tools and processes fitted to how the business runs
5. Bookkeeping — clean, current books
6. AI Implementation — practical AI tools for financial workflows

## About Kolby Benford

Kolby Benford is a licensed Alabama CPA. He spent five years in public accounting (individual and corporate tax, payroll, bookkeeping; real estate tax focus), then served as Controller for an insurance agency in the Florence area (2024). He previously served in the United States Air Force and attended the United States Air Force Academy. He lives in the Tuscumbia area with his wife Leann and son Thomas; they are members of Spring Valley Church of God.

The firm was founded on a stewardship conviction: abilities and resources are meant to be used well — helping clients steward finances so they can pursue their purpose.
